cohort: 31 fetuses referred for fetal cardiovascular magnetic resonance examination after an inconclusive echocardiograph
finding: Fetal cardiovascular magnetic resonance imaging added clinically useful information to what was available from echocardiography in cases of congenital heart defects with inconclusive data from echocardiography.
mod_finding: Fetal cardiovascular magnetic resonance imaging helped with delivery planning in 75% of fetuses with hypoplastic left heart syndrome.
